info.title: Investment Details API - Managed Investments - Async
info.description:
The Investment Details - Managed Investments (Async) API provides direct access to Morningstar’s extensive investment data, enabling batch data downloads for application databasing. It is ideal for backend systems, analytics platforms, and automated financial reporting tools.

**Request Limits**


To ensure predictable performance and efficient processing, the following
limits apply:


**Non-Portfolio Holdings Data**

  - A maximum of **250 investments**.
  - Up to **3 views**.
  - **Up to 60 months** of time series data.

**Portfolio Holdings Data**

  - A maximum of **250 investments**.
  - A single view only. One of:
    - `full-look-through-portfolio-holdings`
    - `full-portfolio-holdings-month-end-or-quarter-end-most-recent`
  - **Up to 60 months** of time series data.
  - **Delta load** supported.


**Identifiers**  

Use the **Universe API** to retrieve Morningstar Performance IDs for the investments in your entitled
universe. See [documentation](https://developer.morningstar.com/direct-web-services/documentation/api-utilities/universe-api/overview) for more information.

**Authentication**  



Use the **Authentication API** to retrieve tokens required to authorize requests. See
[documentation](https://developer.morningstar.com/direct-web-services/documentation/api-utilities/authentication-api/overview) for more information.

post.description:
**Request Limits**

To ensure predictable performance and efficient processing, the following limits apply:

- A **maximum of 250 investments** per request.

- A **maximum of 3 data views** per request **except** when requesting Portfolio Holdings data.
- For Portfolio Holdings pass either `full-look-through-portfolio-holdings` or `full-portfolio-holdings-month-end-or-quarter-end-most-recent`. The view must be the only `viewId` in the request — it cannot be combined with other views or with each other.
- Time series data is available for **up to 60 months**.

- **Delta load** supported for Portfolio Holdings data. Specify a `deltaStartTime` in the request body.

**Request Headers**
  
- The `Prefer` request header is required.

- Set the header to `Prefer: respond-async` to enable asynchronous request processing.

**Response**

The server responds with `HTTP 202 Accepted` status and returns a job identifier in the response body.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description:
Must be set to `respond-async` to indicate the client requires that
the request is processed asynchronously. If omitted or set to another value, the server responds with an error message.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Specifies the investment to query. 
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.

post.description:
This endpoint is used to retrieve dates for which data is available for a portfolio.

These dates are used to specify a portfolio date when requesting investment details for the following views:

- `full-look-through-portfolio-holdings`
- `full-portfolio-holdings-month-end-or-quarter-end-most-recent`

get.description:
Retrieve the list of data views your account is entitled to access,
along with the corresponding `viewId` values required to request
investment details.

RequestInvestmentDetails.title: RequestInvestmentDetails
RequestInvestmentDetails.description: Request investment details for up to 3 views and 250 investments.

portfolioDate.description: Returns portfolio holdings data for the date specified. If no date is passed, the most recently available data is returned. Used when requesting portfolio holdings data only.

deltaStartTime.description:
Required to retrieve a delta load. If not passed, the full load is returned. Retrieves all updates from the given timestamp until current time. Accepts UTC DateTime format. For example `2026-07-02T14:30:00Z`.
**Note:** Used with `full-look-through-portfolio-holdings` and `full-portfolio-holdings-month-end-or-quarter-end-most-recent` view IDs only.

includeUnchangedData.description:
Used when requesting a delta load.
When `true`, returns just the changed rows, but each one complete with all its fields.
When `false`, returns just the changed rows, and within each, only the fields that actually changed.

languageId.description: Specifies the language to filter results on. Required for language-dependent data.

currencyId.description: Specifies the currency to filter results on. Required for currency-dependent data. Accepts 3-character ISO 4217 currency codes.

holdingsView.description: Holdings view to retrieve. Allowed values are `10`, `25`, or `full`.

type.description: Type of portfolio dates to retrieve. Allowed values are `mostRecent`, `timeSeries`, or `staticDates`.

frequency.description: Frequency used when `type` is `timeSeries`. Allowed values are `d` (daily) or `m` (monthly).

startDate.description: Start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Required when `type` is `timeSeries`.

endDate.description: End date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Required when `type` is `timeSeries`.

dates.description: Array of dates in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Required when `type` is `staticDates`. A maximum of 10 items is allowed.

idType.description: Type of identifier provided in the `id` field.

baseCurrency.description: Base currency used to resolve the investment identifier.

domicile.description: Domicile used to resolve the investment identifier.

exchangeCountry.description: Exchange country used to resolve the investment identifier.

exchangeId.description: Specifies exchange identifier used to look up investment. See the data dictionary for full list of accepted values.
